item.title: 【HD Live Performances】FEED - Full feed Sunday - BBC Radio 2 in the park 720p AAC
item.description:
Radio 2 in the park full feed from Sunday in 720p quality.
The first act starts at the 45 minute mark and each act (other than Def Leppard) is an hour after that.
Due to the file hoster I use, the full feed is split into two parts as the file is above 20 gig.
The acts can be found in full in higher quality here: https://sharemania.us/threads/radio...080p-ip-web-dl-aac2-0-h-264-casstudio.283503/
If any of those acts aren't re-uploaded i can upload them in 1080p.
